title: sim-run tests: the T22 sweep checks for survivors right after its last SIGKILL with no wait, so a dying or zombie process can be reported as a survivor (a false failure)
evidence: Found 2026-11-13 in the mac-slot test isolation survey (its F2). ios/scripts/sim-run.test.ts sweep() (:184-198): each pass waits up to 1.5 s only after SIGTERM; after pass 3's SIGKILL the final ours(roots) check (:196-197) runs at once, and ps can still list a process the kernel has not finished killing or reaping. Fix: wait (bounded) for the KILLed pids to go before the final check, as tools/mac-slot.test.ts afterEach does. ios/scripts is an engine path, so the fix waits for the owner
